name: team-avatar
description: Principal-level engineering skills, each owned by a character from Avatar: The Last Airbender. Aang routes the work through avatar-mode. Tool names resolve through skills/avatar-mode/references/codex.md.

interface.shortDescription: Principal-level engineering skills with an Avatar cast
interface.longDescription: Aang routes each task through avatar-mode. Sokka plans, Toph investigates and reviews, Katara heals bugs, Zuko owns performance and incidents, Iroh writes and teaches, Appa ships, and Momo scouts with throwaway prototypes.
